name: That Night With You
source:
After an accident that caused your father’s death a decade ago, you’ve worked hard to try to get into Midnight Serpent Academy, the same one your father has graduated from but unfortunately failed. Luckily you’ve met some friends that helped you with your university life, and even went to a party with them. Yet the next morning you woke up next to a guy whose name is Luneth. What does he want with you? You can’t quite place your finger on it but he seems so familiar in a way. 


In this world where even mere mortals can become sovereigns of their magic’s domain, how will you choose to traverse your fate?

[From [url=https://lovielunachu.itch.io/that-night-with-you]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
十年前一场事故导致你父亲去世后，你努力尝试进入午夜蛇学院，你父亲也是从这所学校毕业的，但不幸的是失败了。幸运的是，你遇到了一些在大学生活中为你提供帮助的朋友，甚至和他们一起参加了聚会。然而第二天早上，你在一个名叫卢内斯的人身边醒来。他想和你做什么？你无法确切地指出它的具体位置，但他在某种程度上看起来很熟悉。


在这个凡人也能成为魔法领域主宰的世界里，你将如何选择穿越命运？

[来自[url=https://lovielunachu.itch.io/that-night-with-you]itch.io[/url]]
